# Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas (v2.11.0)

> Exhaustive, cryptographically audited cross-disciplinary open-problem research infrastructure: 2,000 strictly deduplicated unsolved, open, and hard problems spanning 8 Macro-Pillars, 28 Superdomains, 8 Physical/Formal Substrates, and 7 Abstraction Layers (including 100 strictly non-duplicate open conjectures verified verbatim across the 25 baseline fronts of Left to Solve, `lefttosolve.com/programs`, backed by a daily-synced 26-front / 62,790-target local mirror and 291 crosswalk matches) wired into 1 biconnected 6,108-edge knowledge graph (audited in Python/NetworkX: 0 articulation points, 0 bridges, 0 dangling links), paired with 103 audited Lean 4.35.0 software-model invariant theorems (of 117 declarations in `lean/`, 14 files / 1,711 lines; 9 Palomar targets checked by 6 kernel checks across 5 distinct implementations + live negative kernel rejection), an 11-page AMS-LaTeX white paper (15/15 title-verified citations, 0 retractions), structurally verified DigiCert RFC 3161 (`.tsr`) + 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps v1 (`.ots`) proofs, automated daily syncing of 16 public trackers & all live Left to Solve fronts (`.github/workflows/daily-registry-sync.yml`), offline sovereign target radar, strict-CSP WCAG 2.2 AA web apps, offline SQLite FTS5 Hybrid RAG (100.0% MRR@5), a 13-tool stdio MCP server (incl. `simulate_rubric_override`, `get_live_registry_tracker`, & `query_lefttosolve_programs`), 3 reproducible Track B exact finite probes (`LOG-002`, `NT-005`, `COMB-002`), 14/14 mutation testing, 115 pytest checks, and an immutable Karpathy-style AutoResearch harness (AQS = 98.35).

- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`)
- **Dual License:** Data/Figures/White Paper `CC-BY-4.0` · Code/Lean/RAG/MCP `Apache-2.0`
- **Honest Boundary:** Zero (`0/2,000`) overarching Atlas problems are solved or retired; Lean verifies software-model invariants only (not the 2,000-row data or its graph); rubric scores are falsifiable editorial estimates.

## Formal Proofs, White Paper & Interactive Interfaces

- [AMS-LaTeX White Paper PDF](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/blob/main/dist/Donahue_2026_unsolved_problems_mega_atlas.pdf): 11-page publication-grade Tectonic PDF (`0` overfull hboxes)
- [Interactive Web Atlas](https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/): WCAG 2.2 AA browser explorer for all 2,000 problems, 26 live Left to Solve fronts & 15 charts
- [Daily Registry Tracker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/docs/DAILY_REGISTRY_TRACKER.md): Auto-updated daily (`06:00 UTC`) status across 16 global open-problem trackers & 26 live Left to Solve fronts
- [Interactive Lean 4.35.0 Proof Blueprint](https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/blueprint/): SVG dependency DAG & module inventory for all 103 audited software-model theorems
- [Verbatim Lean Axiom Audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/results/lean_axioms.txt): All 103 `#print axioms` lines (`⊆ [propext, Quot.sound]`)
- [RFC 3161 Trusted Timestamp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/CHECKSUMS.sha256.tsr): DigiCert RFC 3161 timestamp reply binding `CHECKSUMS.sha256`
- [Bitcoin OpenTimestamps Proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/CHECKSUMS.sha256.ots): 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps v1 proof binding `CHECKSUMS.sha256`
- [FAIR Metadata (Croissant 1.0)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/croissant.json): MLCommons Croissant JSON-LD descriptor

- [Master Ranking (`RANKING.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/main/RANKING.md): Top 250 problems by 0thernes CSS + Nov 27, 2026 AI watchlist & 20-row Cycle-3 companion ledger
